claims.text: Existing multimodal sentiment analysis methods rely on Pre-trained Language Models to extract semantic information from textual data but lack an in-depth understanding of logical relationships within the text modality.
The PEAR CoT prompt induces Large Language Models to generate text-based reasoning processes and zero-shot sentiment prediction results.
Text-based Chain-of-Thought reasoning is not always reliable and can contain irrational steps due to LLM hallucinations.
The filtering submodule in the Cross-Modal Filtering and Fusion module utilizes audio and visual modalities to suppress irrational steps in Chain-of-Thought reasoning.
The fusion submodule integrates high-level reasoning information and cross-modal complementary information during semantic representation learning.
High-level reasoning information helps learn discriminative text representation.
Cross-modal complementary information avoids misleading by unreasonable steps in Chain-of-Thought reasoning.
MM-PEAR-CoT achieves a 2.2% improvement in binary classification accuracy on the CMU-MOSI dataset.
MM-PEAR-CoT achieves a 1.7% improvement in binary classification accuracy on the CMU-MOSEI dataset.

evidence.description: Experimental results show an improvement of 2.2% in binary classification accuracy on the CMU-MOSI dataset.
Experimental results show an improvement of 1.7% in binary classification accuracy on the CMU-MOSEI dataset.

methodologies.name: Multimodal PEAR Chain-of-Thought (MM-PEAR-CoT)
methodologies.description: A multimodal sentiment analysis framework incorporating PEAR CoT prompting for LLMs combined with a Cross-Modal Filtering and Fusion module to prune irrational steps using audio/visual signals.
conditions: zero-shot sentiment prediction via PEAR CoT
cross-modal filtering using audio and visual modalities

limitations.text: Text-based CoT reasoning is not always reliable and might contain irrational steps due to the hallucinations of LLMs.
Existing PLM-based methods lack an in-depth understanding of logical relationships within the text modality.
